task.dtype: u8 stream, exact level-12 Mech/Roc bytes
task.arithmetic: Checked unsigned integer operations; level 12; complete input consumed; valid raw DEFLATE stream required
task.ordering: Owned prefix followed by complete DEFLATE stream; no trailing data; Mech/Roc must equal pinned/reference bytes; libdeflate may produce different valid bytes
task.ownership: Input and prefix snapshots survive the call unchanged; result remains independently owned; all managed storage released after outputs and inputs drop

measurement.setup: Source/bytecode compilation, JIT preparation, input snapshot admission and warmup excluded and recorded separately; fresh compiler process per fork
measurement.reset: Fresh process for every independent fork
measurement.warmup: None outside process; runtime JIT preparation included where applicable
measurement.destruction: Compressor scratch cleanup included; returned output and caller snapshots released after the timed call
measurement.cache: OS caches uncontrolled; independent process forks
measurement.transport: Mech typed snapshots; Roc borrowed list aliases; libdeflate borrowed slices with separately owned output; boundaries differ and no cross-runtime speed ratio is automatically qualified
